notes.title: Follow up and new information on update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

I'm working hard and things are progressing well for the next update 2.0, which will bring a whole new start to the game.

Here is the new structure of the game, 4 main steps to complete the game:

- Protect the base and build the necessary protection and survival elements.

- Repaired and improved a bus to have a mobile base and explore the map.

- Build a laboratory and make a vaccine to cure infected people.

- Recruit people and build a guerrilla to fight the aliens.

Also, a brand new economy system has been developed, a new loot system with over 150 different items, a new crafting system with over 60 craftable items and the addition of vendors to buy or sell your loot.

A brand new system for the management of enemies in real time, currently there are 3000 live zombies on the map in a totally random way, and this without any loss of performance.

Thank you for your support and patience.

- Recruit people and build a guerrilla to fight the aliens.

Also, a brand new economy system has been developed, a new loot system with over 150 different items, a new crafting system with over 60 craftable items and the addition of vendors to buy or sell your loot.
A brand new system for the management of enemies in real time, currently there are 3000 live zombies on the map in a totally random way, and this without any loss of performance.

notes.title: Follow about the next update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is a follow up with you on the work that is in progress for my next update, which will introduce a new version of Invasion 2037. 

In this new new version,  you will now be able to build your own base with your laboratory, your infirmary and more, you will also be able to install automatic weapons to protect your base. Also you will be able to repair a school bus and use it as a mobile base and equip it to strengthen it and add weapons to it. 

I will tell you more news about those new gameplay next month. However, this new update will not be available before the end of the year, I will keep you updated every month on the progress of the work. 

Thank you for your support and your patience.

Here is 2 new screenshots with the school bus :

https://imgur.com/37qiYJX
https://imgur.com/ayy3rpV

notes.title: New Infomations about the new version
notes.content:
Here is more informations about the revamp version of Invasion 2037 that i am working on. I want you to know that this new version will be a free update. I am sharing with you some screenshots is this new version.

Here is some new features implemented :

- A new Day and night dynamic system
- A new TPS and true FPS view
- The cars have damage
- All the enemy AI have been revamp
- The new map size is 144 KM2 compare to the actual map 16 KM2
- The new map load 20x faster and used less memory

notes.title: INVASION 2037 - UPDATE 1.1.35
notes.content:
- New: The city up north has been completely redone with new buildings with less polygon and lighter textures. The city was also reduced to take less memory. Access to the city was made easier by removing the extra terrestrial and enemy vessels in front of the bridge.

- New: An icon has been added to the HUD to see the position of your car at all times.

- Fix: I added a fence around the entrance of the bunker to prevent parking the car in the player's spawn

- Fix: The damage limit to repair the car has been removed, you can now repair it at any time

- Fix: An icon has been added to the HUD to see the position of your car at all times.

- Fix: The first 6 slots in your inventory are now accessible with the keys 4 to 9 on the keyboard, so you 
  can heal quickly.

- Fix: The Character running speed increased by 35%

(Restart Steam to receive the update immediately)
